name: HSEEP (Homeland Security Exercise and Evaluation Program)
description: A U.S. DHS capability-based exercise design, conduct, and evaluation methodology. Includes tabletop exercises, functional exercises, and full-scale exercises with after-action reports.
reputation: Federal standard for emergency preparedness exercises in U.S.; free training and templates available.
notes: Exercise quality depends heavily on facilitator expertise; AARs often underfollowed.
